name: stale_aggregate
description: In main.go, the PUT /api/orders/:o_orderkey/lineitems/:l_linenumber handler updates lineitem.l_extendedprice, l_discount, and l_tax but never recomputes or updates the parent orders.o_totalprice. The GET /api/orders/:o_orderkey handler then reads o_totalprice directly from orders, so after a line item change it can serve a stale aggregate value.
